Scarlet & Violet series · WHT

White Flare

Released July 18, 2025 · 173 cards

StandardExpanded

White Flare is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on July 18, 2025. Its main set has 86 cards, plus 87 secret rares numbered beyond the set (173 in total). It includes 162 Pokémon, 10 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
